description:
• About our brand and products: 

It all started in 2021 with a simple yet powerful insight: our homes are our sanctuaries, but keeping them clean often feels like a chore that steals our precious time.We saw parents missing out on moments of play with their kids, and busy professionals giving up weekends to endless cleaning tasks. We believed it shouldn’t be this way. What if technology could give you that time back? What if cleaning wasn’t a burden, but a seamless part of everyday life?That “what if” became our mission. lubluelu was founded to make daily cleaning effortless.


• What makes us different: 

  1. High Commission Rates - Competitive commission structure with attractive earning potential.
  2. Trusted Brand - Established reputation in the industry, ensuring reliability and trustworthiness for affiliates.
  3. Exclusive Promotions - Access to special offers and unique deals that increase conversion rates.
  4. Timely Payments - Fast and reliable payment system with various payout options.
  5. Dedicated Affiliate Support - A dedicated team to assist affiliates with any needs or questions.
  6. Comprehensive Tracking Tools - Advanced tracking system that ensures transparency and accurate performance measurement.
  7. Global Reach - Opportunities to promote products to a global audience.


• How affiliates can earn: 

Affiliates can earn by promoting lubluelu products across various platforms, including blogs, websites, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and so on. When you drive sales through your unique referral links, you will receive commissions based on the sales generated. We offer exclusive discount codes for your audience, helping you increase conversions. As soon as an order is captured through your referral, you will earn commissions according to the sales volume and commission percentage.

Additionally, sample products are available upon request to help you promote more effectively.


• How to promote us:

  1. Create Content on Your Platforms: Share engaging content about Lubluelu on your blog, website, Instagram, YouTube, or Facebook. This could be reviews, tutorials, unboxings, or product features.
  2. Use Your Unique Referral Links: Embed your unique affiliate link in your posts, videos, or descriptions. When followers make a purchase through your link, you'll earn a commission.
  3. Offer Exclusive Discount Codes: Share our exclusive discount codes with your audience to incentivize them to purchase and increase conversion rates, if needed.
  4. Leverage Social Media: Post on Instagram, Facebook, or YouTube to reach a wider audience. Use eye-catching visuals and highlight the benefits of Lubluelu products.
  5. Email Campaigns: Send out promotional emails to your subscriber list, sharing updates, product launches, or exclusive offers, all while embedding your affiliate link.
  6. Product Reviews and Demos: If possible, request free samples from us and create product review videos or blog posts to show your audience the benefits and quality of our products.


• Other information: 

For any questions, please contact us via email: affiliate@lubluelu.com
term_and_condition:
Welcome to the https://lubluelu.com/de affiliate programme. As a lubluelu affiliate, we ask that you read our T&C’s carefully. If you have any doubts on how to promote, please contact: affiliate@lubluelu.com. 

General Promotions
Only promote active offers and pricing provided by https://lubluelu.com/de. Ensure that all information linked to the site is accurate. Miscommunication of offers or pricing may lead to removal from the programme. Regular miscommunication of pricing and offers will result in being removed from the programme. 

Commission
The default commission rate starts at 3%, increasing based on publisher type and promotional method. Commission will not be granted on orders made using pre-purchased gift cards. Whilst we are open to all partner types it must be completely clear as to how https://lubluelu.com/de must be promoted - you as the affiliate must be able to provide this as requested. See publisher types below: 
Content / Review / Influencer  - upto 10%, 
Blog / Community / Email - upto 7%, 
Coupon / Deal /  Loyalty / Cashback / Subnetwork - upto 5%, 
CSS / Comparison - upto 4%, 
Browser Extension / Auto Coupon / Auto Cashback - upto 3%. 
We are not liable for untracked sales or commission due to technical disruptions. We do not include VAT and shipping when calculating commission costs. 

Exclusive Promotions and Voucher codes
https://lubluelu.com/de reserves the right to add, amend, withdraw promotions as used by individual affiliates at any given time without the necessity to provide valid reason. Only promote voucher codes intended for the affiliate channel, supplied by lubluelu affiliate team. Promoting voucher codes that are not intended for the affiliate channel may result in declined commissions. 

Branding
When referencing https://lubluelu.com/de, we ask that you use the most current logo as seen on the network profile. For asset resizing queries, contact: affiliate@lubluelu.com.

Contact
For overarching enquiries, email https://lubluelu.com/de affiliate team: affiliate@lubluelu.com.

Marking your Work with our Brand as Advertising.
As a representative of the https://lubluelu.com/de brand, you must comply with affiliate marketing regulations when promoting any codes.
Any aspect of activity as part of promoting the https://lubluelu.com/de Affiliate programme must be marked as paid advertising as clearly as possible, using such labels as “#Ad”, “AD” or “Advertisement Feature” after or before captions or in-image copy. Failure to comply will result in removal from the programme.
Any paid content in promotion of https://lubluelu.com/de must be approved by affiliate@lubluelu.com, including copy, video, emails and creative. 

PPC & Landing Pages
Brand bidding is generally not allowed. However, we may collaborate with selected partners on a campaign basis, subject to pre-agreement and limited to the campaign duration. This activity will not be allowed on pure brand terms. Partners bidding on brand terms or brand+voucher terms outside an approved campaign will receive a warning. Repeated violations will lead to suspension and declined commissions. This includes but is not exhaustive of the following terms: 
https://lubluelu.com/de, 
https://lubluelu.com/de voucher, 
https://lubluelu.com/de code, 
https://lubluelu.com/de discount, 
https://lubluelu.com/de promo code, 
https://lubluelu.com/de coupon, 
lubluelu code promo. 

Apps
Affiliates using unauthorized third-party apps, websites, or imitating the https://lubluelu.com/de brand may be removed from the programme.

Terms and Conditions
Any specific terms relating to our programme, offers or brand must be clearly displayed to customers on your website, promotional content or social media. If you would like to work with us on a further or additional market, please email to discuss. 

Product Feeds & CSS Google Shopping
Available via AWIN, The https://lubluelu.com/de Affiliate programme offers partner product lists updated daily. Unless you have stated in writing by https://lubluelu.com/de, CSS Google Shopping activity is not permitted. If you are a CSS partner, we would like to understand more about who you are and have an awareness that you are running CSS activity - please reach out to our team and disclose that you intend for CSS to be a means of promotion. 

Sub-networks
Sub-networks must provide full visibility of potential partners before adding them to the programme and must obtain permission from https://lubluelu.com/de. Sub-networks must not work with social media/blog publishers or sites hosting user-generated content, without explicit permission from https://lubluelu.com/de and all partners operating under the network must be compliant to this criterion. Sub-networks must be able to switch off partners within 48 hours. 

Creative
https://lubluelu.com/de does not permit any programme affiliates to alter creative or text links available through the AWIN platform. Beyond that, https://lubluelu.com/de does not permit any affiliates to hardcode banners into the web platforms or sites, as updates via AWIN will not take immediate effect. 
Should you be found to infringe on this, your commissions may be reversed. We reserve the right to withhold commissions during the infringement period, with permanent suspension for repeated offences.
Bespoke creative can be supplied on request to suit your platform, so please get in touch with affiliate@lubluelu.com for further support from our in-house experts. 

Email Marketing
All email marketing must be approved by https://lubluelu.com/de before going live. Please send submissions to: affiliate@lubluelu.com.

Toolbar Affiliates
https://lubluelu.com/de does not accept or collaborate with any detail of toolbar affiliates. 

Affiliate Approvals
Prior to collaboration, all affiliate sites are audited to ensure any brand compliance issues that may exist are met - to ensure that https://lubluelu.com/de’s image is not tainted. Affiliates without a valid URL will be immediately rejected.

Validations
Within a 30 day period, https://lubluelu.com/de will validate all commissions and reserve the right to claim commission on returned goods. Please consider this when reviewing payments for pending sales.
Find reasons below for declined commission: 
UNVERIFIED ORDERS, 
GLOBAL SHIPPING, 
ORDERS MADE AND APPROVED PRIOR, 
EXPIRED TRANSACTIONS OR BASKETS, 
ANY USE OF STAFF DISCOUNT, 
RETURNED ORDERS, 
CANCELLED ORDERS, 
INCOMPLETE PENDING ORDERS, 
UNRELATED VOUCHER USAGE, 
Information regarding transaction queries - all transaction queries must be made via the AWIN platform within 2 months following the sale. Any queries made more than 2 months after the sale will be automatically declined. A continual failure to comply with any terms may result in the termination of any collaboration with https://lubluelu.com/de. 

Notice Periods
https://lubluelu.com/de will give a minimum of 7 days notice where possible prior to any major changes to our ongoing affiliate relationships, however in exceptional circumstances changes may be made prior. Affiliates must monitor AWIN’s automated emails for updates, as we may not contact you directly.

Performance Benchmarks
https://lubluelu.com/de values relationships with affiliates who promote their brands to their optimal capacity, we reserve the right to remove any under-performing affiliate due to a lack of capacity. 

Our minimum payout threshold has recently been updated to €50. Once your approved commission balance reaches €50, you can submit a payout request.

We generally arrange affiliate payments twice a month, around the middle and end of each month, depending on the payment schedule and processing status.
